search.query: index=main sourcetype="nvidia:smi" | stats latest(temperature.gpu_temp) as Temp latest(utilization.gpu_util) as "GPU Util" latest(utilization.memory_util) as "Mem Util" latest(fb_memory_usage.used) as "Mem Used" latest(fb_memory_usage.total) as "Mem Total" latest(gpu_power_readings.average_power_draw) as Power latest(fan_speed) as Fan latest(persistence_mode) as Persistence latest(driver_version) as Driver latest(vbios_version) as "VBIOS" by gpu_index product_name | rename gpu_index as "GPU", product_name as "Product"

index=main sourcetype="nvidia:smi" | eval util=tonumber(substr('utilization.gpu_util',1,if('utilization.gpu_util'=="N/A",-1,length('utilization.gpu_util')-2))) | timechart span=1m avg(util) as "GPU Util %" by product_name
index=main sourcetype="nvidia:smi" | eval mem_used=tonumber(trim('fb_memory_usage.used',"%sMiB")) | timechart span=1m avg(mem_used) as "Memory Used" by product_name
index=main sourcetype="nvidia:smi" | eval temp=tonumber(trim('temperature.gpu_temp'," C")) | timechart span=1m avg(temp) as "GPU Temp" by product_name
index=main sourcetype="nvidia:smi" | eval power_w=tonumber(trim('gpu_power_readings.average_power_draw'," W")) | timechart span=1m avg(power_w) as "Avg Power (W)" by product_name

index=main sourcetype="nvidia:smi" | head 1 | spath input=_raw path=compute_processes{} output=proc | mvexpand proc | spath input=proc | table pid, process_name, used_memory, type | rename used_memory as "Used GPU Memory (MiB)", type as "Process Type", pid as PID, process_name as "Process"
